what: gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16 decodes 0.85% slower in the 2026-08-24 campaign than in the 2026-07-25 one, at every context length, and the cause is not known.
why_it_is_here: It is the one of six controls whose offset is both sizeable and tightly measured. gemma-4-12B at TP=1 is nominally -0.82% but spans -3.95 to +1.50, wide enough that its mean says nothing; the other four reproduce July within 0.25%. Publishing a campaign comparison means saying what did not reconcile, not only what did.
measured: 2026-08-24 18:05 UTC (in campaign), 2026-08-24 22:08 UTC (cold), 2026-08-24 22:30 UTC (warm, started immediately after the cold run)

machine.gpu: 2x Radeon RX 7900 XT (gfx1100), TP=2, VFIO guest
machine.note: the August container also carries PR#49991's clone flag, PR#45916's split-KV with the gate widened, and the sliding-window block skip. None reaches gemma-4's decode path: vLLM forces it onto TRITON_ATTN because its head dimensions are heterogeneous, and that backend's kernel already bounds its loop by the window. It is not that the model has no window — it has 1024 on 50 of its 60 layers — it is that the patched kernel is not the one it runs.

reproducibility.reading: Three independent runs agree to 0.077% RSD. The offset is about eleven times that, so it is a property of the two campaigns and not of any one run.

temperature_is_not_the_cause.design: Run 2 started on a machine idle for 13 minutes at 38C junction. Run 3 started immediately after run 2 finished. Junction was sampled every 15 s throughout run 3.
temperature_is_not_the_cause.reading: Junction climbs from 58C to 99C inside a single 19-minute configuration, so both runs cover most of the range regardless of how they started. Across that range the warm run is 0.11% faster than the cold one, with the per-point range spanning zero. No thermal effect on decode throughput is measurable here between 38C and 100C. Power draw is identical to July's, which is not what throttling looks like.
temperature_is_not_the_cause.separate_hardware_note: 96-99C junction under sustained decode is 6-9C above the 2026-07-23 acceptance test for the interposed fan (92.8C card1, 90.1C card2, 8-way concurrent load). It remains 11C below the 110C throttle line. That is a cooling observation, not an explanation of the offset.

ruled_out: The w4a16 kernel path. gemma-4-12B is the same quantisation on the same path and reproduces July at -0.02%.
A machine-wide regression. Qwen3-8B -0.10%, gemma-4-26B-A4B -0.23%, Qwen3-8B at TP=1 +0.01%.
Run-to-run variance. 0.077% RSD across three runs against a 0.85% offset.
Campaign position. July's run was fifth, two hours in; run 1 was first on a cold machine; both are 0.85% apart from July in the same direction.
not_ruled_out: PCIe AtomicOps. The guest had none in July and has them now: hostpciX was rewritten from the all-functions form to the single-function one on 2026-08-23 at 14:17 UTC, twenty-eight hours before the August campaign. Cheapest of the three to test — put hostpciX back and rerun this one configuration.
The guest kernel, 7.0.0-28 to 7.0.0-30. It is the largest uncontrolled difference, but it should not be selective for one model when three others on the same machine are unaffected.
Something in the vLLM build between 0.23 and 0.23.1.dev1 that touches this model's shape specifically.
A difference in the model files themselves. Not checked: no checksum of the July weights was kept.
